summary: Ronald Eugene Stamm, 38, of Aurora, CO, hiked to Agnes Vaille Falls on May 27, 2025 with his wife and juvenile daughter; he continued alone toward the falls, attempted to climb the cliff face without equipment, lost his grip and fell over a hundred feet to the creek bottom. He did not survive and was pronounced deceased at the scene by the Chaffee County Coroner; Chaffee County Search and Rescue North assisted with recovering his body to the trailhead.
responding_agency: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office; Chaffee County Search and Rescue North
notes: Victim was hiking with wife and juvenile daughter; he continued alone toward the falls and attempted to climb the cliff face. Source: Chaffee County Sheriff's Office Facebook page.
